title: Digital clock: AM/PM is not localized and interrelated issues
line: The clock now writes AM/PM in the case the language uses, so Greek shows lower-case π.μ./μ.μ
explanation: The English-only AM/PM was already fixed in 6.6.1, but timeFormatCorrection() in DigitalClock.qml still appended the "AP" token, which Qt always turns into upper case. Greek (and other locales) write AM/PM in lower case, so the clock showed Π.Μ. instead of π.μ. The change uses Qt's "Ap" token, which keeps the locale's own case.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: use the locale's own case for AM/PM

The clock forced the AM/PM text to upper case, so locales that write it
in lower case, like Greek with π.μ. and μ.μ., showed it wrongly. Use the
"Ap" format, which keeps the case the locale gives the AM/PM text.

BUG: 497514

patches.diff:
From 109a1a2ebe7d72ba55c2fa44d2b5314396c14bf2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:55:28 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: use the locale's own case for AM/PM
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The clock forced the AM/PM text to upper case, so locales that write it
in lower case, like Greek with π.μ. and μ.μ., showed it wrongly. Use the
"Ap" format, which keeps the case the locale gives the AM/PM text.

BUG: 497514
---
 applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
index 8c918109d0..24dac2bc85 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
@@ -526,7 +526,7 @@ MouseArea {
         const delimiter = match[2];
         const minutes = match[3]
         const seconds = "ss";
-        const amPm = "AP";
+        const amPm = "Ap";
         const uses24hFormatByDefault = timeFormatString.toLowerCase().indexOf("ap") === -1;
 
         // because QLocale is incredibly stupid and does not convert 12h/24h clock format
-- 
2.53.0

Same setup with the fix: π.μ.
